standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the DM stack at a point whose residue field will present the stack nearby.

standard_prerequisites.name: The existence of a surjective etale morphism from the spectrum of a field onto a one-point DM Noetherian reduced stack
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 4615-4617)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the field and the etale map over the residual gerbe.

standard_prerequisites.name: The statement that an etale morphism of algebraic spaces which is universally injective is an open immersion
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 4440-4444 region, used at lines 4632-4636) as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes the diagonal of the comparison morphism of the presentation an open immersion.

standard_prerequisites.name: The slice lemma, producing locally on the presentation a closed subscheme flat and locally of finite presentation over the stack
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 4680-4686)
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the closed subscheme cut out by a regular sequence near the point.

standard_prerequisites.name: The statement that a morphism which is flat, locally of finite presentation and unramified at a point is etale after shrinking the source
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked near the end of the counted proof (source lines 4707-4710)
standard_prerequisites.use: Converts the unramifiedness at the point into etaleness on a neighbourhood.

core_obligations: Reduce to the pointwise statement: the implications among the three conditions are recalled, with (3) implies (1) done, and it remains to attach to every finite type point a scheme mapping etale to the stack and covering a neighbourhood of it (proof lines 4599-4607)

Residual gerbe: at a finite type point the residual gerbe exists, is locally of finite type over the stack and is DM, so it admits a surjective etale morphism from the spectrum of a field (proof lines 4608-4619)

Unramified comparison morphism: choosing a smooth presentation through which the point factors, the fibre product of the presentation with the residue field point is nonempty and has etale comparison morphisms, so its diagonal is an open immersion and the comparison morphism to the presentation is unramified (proof lines 4620-4643)

Slice: a closed point of an etale cover of that fibre gives a finite separable extension of the residue field and a regular sequence in the local ring of the presentation, and the slice lemma produces a closed subscheme flat and locally of finite presentation over the stack on a neighbourhood, whose local ring at the point is exactly that extension (proof lines 4644-4700)

Etaleness and conclusion: the closed subscheme is unramified at the point by the local criterion, so the local criterion for etaleness makes it etale after shrinking, and the disjoint union of these morphisms over all finite type points is a surjective etale morphism from a scheme because the image of its space is open and contains every finite type point (proof lines 4701-4738)
proof_roadmap: 对有限型点 x：残差 gerbe Z_x 存在、在 X 上局部有限型、且 DM ⇒ 由 lemma-DM-residual-gerbe 存在域 k 与满 étale 的 Spec(k) → Z_x。
取 U → X 光滑使 x 在 |U| 的像中，F = U ×_X Spec(k) 非空；由 Z_x → X 是单态射得 F ×_U F 的两支 étale ⇒ Δ_{F/U} étale ⇒（étale + 一致单射 ⇒ 开浸入）⇒ F → U unramified。
取非空仿射 V → F 的 étale 覆盖，取 k ⊂ κ(v) 有限可分的闭点 v；φ: O_{U,u} → O_{V,v} 满足 φ(m_u)O_{V,v} = m_v ⇒ 取 f_1..f_d 使像构成 m_v/m_v² 的基 ⇒ 正则序列；缩 U 使 f_i 是整体截面，再由 slice 引理缩到 V(f_1..f_d) → X 平坦局部有限表现。
V(f_1..f_d) ×_U V 是 V 中被 f_i|_V 截出的闭子概型 T，且 O_{T,v} = κ(v)（k 的有限可分扩张）⇒ T → Spec(k) 在 v 处 unramified ⇒ 由 etale-at-point 缩 U 后 V(f_1..f_d) → X 是 étale。
拼起来：W = ∐_x W_x，f = ∐ f_x 是 étale；其空间像是开的且含全部有限型点 ⇒ 由足够有限型点引理 f 满。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the author's theorem characterizing DM algebraic stacks through the existence of a surjective etale morphism from a scheme (source lines 4588-4597, label theorem-DM); the author's own proof at source lines 4599-4739 follows it immediately and is its proof. The proof produces, at each finite type point, a scheme etale over the stack and covering a neighbourhood: it uses the residual gerbe, the field-valued etale cover of a one-point DM stack, the etale diagonal of a presentation, the slice lemma to cut out a regular sequence and the local criterion for etaleness, and finishes by taking the disjoint union over all finite type points and applying the density of finite type points (proof lines 4599-4738). This is one of the two structural theorems of the chapter. H3.
